dispatch_instance_contended.description: A policy admission found the instance's admission guard taken by a keyless observe or probe for its whole short retry (about 100 ms). The dispatch intent already written is rejected at info; the candidate may run again from next_eligible_unix_ms, about one second later.
dispatch_instance_contended.common_causes: A read-only observation or a monitor probe of the instance was in progress when the dispatch was admitted.
dispatch_instance_contended.handling: Nothing to repair. The next policy evaluation dispatches the candidate once the observation has finished.

dispatch_instance_held.description: A policy candidate, or its admission, met an instance that a claim holds or that an eligible claim waits for (holder_kind names the holder, or the waiting claim that receives the key next; count is the number of eligible waiting claims). The candidate is deferred with no wake, or its intent is rejected at info; the policy driver evaluates again when a lease is released, transferred or expires.
dispatch_instance_held.common_causes: A stuck-recovery ladder, a startup package, an operator command or a direct task run holds the instance, or waits for it, when a dispatch is due.
dispatch_instance_held.handling: Nothing to repair. The candidate runs after the holder releases the instance; actingctl status shows lease_active and queued_request_count meanwhile.

maintenance_artifact_material_unavailabl.description: ledger-maintenance refused a root whose artifact retention is not settled: on a formal root an eviction intent without its outcome (pending_evictions counts the artifacts), on a Segment root any recorded eviction.
maintenance_artifact_material_unavailabl.common_causes: A hard stop (power loss, forced reboot) between an eviction intent and its outcome; a Segment root that already records evictions.
maintenance_artifact_material_unavailabl.handling: Start actingd once on the root so that startup recovery finishes the pending eviction, then run the maintenance operation again.

material_read_missing.description: A material read found no file for an artifact that has no eviction proof; the read result is missing and the Runtime records nothing.
material_read_missing.common_causes: A frame deleted by hand from the state root's artifacts folder.
material_read_missing.handling: Nothing to repair in the Runtime; the frame is gone. Read another frame, or restore the file from a copy if it is still needed.

proposal_report_unavailable.description: A proposal or strategic report request was refused because a verified report artifact could not be read back: a proposal's cited report, or the stored report that a strategic report with identical content would reuse.
proposal_report_unavailable.common_causes: The report file was deleted by hand or damaged after it was recorded.
proposal_report_unavailable.handling: Restore the report file from a copy if it is still needed. Otherwise prepare a strategic report whose content differs (for example a later as-of position), which records a new report artifact, and cite that report.

strategic_evidence_unavailable.description: A strategic report request was refused because one of its verified evidence artifacts could not be read back.
strategic_evidence_unavailable.common_causes: An evidence frame or file was deleted by hand or damaged after it was recorded.
strategic_evidence_unavailable.handling: Cite evidence whose files still exist, then submit the report again.
